pool.text: Sultan Fakhruddin Mubarak Shah of Sonargaon conquered Chittagong.
Dhaniya Manikya successfully conquered Chittagong during this year.
The nearby island of Sandwip was successfully conquered.
The Mughal Empire officially expelled the Portuguese and Arakanese.
Umed Khan built the mosque after the Mughal conquest.
The Kadam Mubarak Mosque in Jamal Khan was built.
Chittagong was officially declared a Major Port of British India.
Bengali revolutionaries carried out the famous Chittagong armoury raid.
The Kalurghat Bridge was officially completed.
The Partition of British India made Chittagong the chief port of East Pakistan.
The Chittagong Tea Auction was officially set up.
The Africawala brothers set up the first steel re-rolling mills.
The Karnaphuli Paper Mills were established.
The University of Chittagong was established as a major university.
GlaxoSmithKline began its operations in Chittagong.
Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology was established.
Chittagong was the site of the Bangladeshi declaration of independence.
The airport officially became a Bangladeshi airport after the liberation war.
Zia was assassinated during an attempted military coup.
The Chittagong Stock Exchange was formed, boosting private sector investments.
